title: 第11章 下山历练师兄安排第12章 师兄的悲惨遭遇信回来了
content_zh:
“哈哈哈，我道是为何今天喜鹊叫唤不停，原来是师弟上门，来，请进。”
洞府里面，十分简单，看着像是难民营一样。
许君白不想来的，整个白云派，谁不知道宋师兄最有钱，乃是一个真正的生意人。
他的名言乃是为了钱，可以做任何事情，只要你给得起钱，叫你爸爸都可以。
一个十分有趣又十分有底线的人。
他的底线就是钱。
“不知道师弟今日前来找师兄所为何事？”
富贵是什么？你先说了，我再给你斟茶，我的茶叶可是灵茶，珍贵着呢，半块灵石一斤那种，不是谁都可以喝的。
许君白看着宋师兄的举动，嘴角抽搐，再次认识了这位师兄，可真是一个奇葩。
白云派内什么都不多，就是奇葩多。
“宋师兄，事情是这样的，师弟我呢，最近接了一桩任务，可是呢，这一桩任务师弟发现完成不了，思来想去，想到了宋师兄，白云派谁不知道宋师兄为人厚道，办事靠谱，没有宋师兄完不成的任务，也没有宋师兄不敢做的事情。”
“师弟这不是想着给宋师兄送一桩富贵，这一封信报酬十分丰厚，师弟愿意都让给师兄你，不知道师兄意下如何？”
宋真罗师兄没有立刻答应，而是眯着眼注视着许君白。
那双眼睛，让人压力很大，似乎要看穿许君白的内心。
许君白保持不变，和宋师兄打交道多了，自然就明白了怎么应对。
“什么信？”
许君白递过去，宋师兄看了看，信封被封禁了，外人无法打开。
感受这封信上面的灵气波动，还有那股封禁的真气，宋师兄脸色有些奇怪。
“师弟，不知道这封信多少报酬？”
先不答应，谈好价格再说。

此乃宋师兄的谨慎，也是他的要价之道。
“三十灵石，如何？”
宋真罗师兄眯着眼，没有答应。
一看就知道对这个价格不满意。
他又问：“送去哪里？”
“飞仙宗。”
“哪里？”宋师兄坐直了身躯。
目光有些集中，盯着许君白看。
“师弟，你说这封信送去哪里？”
“飞仙宗，有问题吗？”
宋师兄声音都变大了。
content_en:
"Hahaha, I wonder why the magpies keep chirping today. It turns out that it's my junior brother who is coming to the door. Come on, please come in."
Inside the cave, it is very simple and looks like a refugee camp.
Xu Junbai didn't want to come. No one in the entire Baiyun Sect knew that Senior Brother Song was the richest and a real businessman.
His famous saying is that for money, you can do anything. As long as you can afford the money, you can call you dad.
A very interesting and very bottom-line person.
His bottom line is money.
"I wonder why Junior Brother came to see Senior Brother today?"
What is wealth? You say it first, and then I'll pour you some tea. My tea is spiritual tea, and it's very precious. Not everyone can drink it, half a pound of spiritual stone.
Xu Junbai looked at Senior Brother Song's actions, and the corner of his mouth twitched. He knew this Senior Brother again, what a strange person he was.
There isn't much in the Baiyun Sect, just a lot of weird things.
"Senior Brother Song, here's the thing. As for me, I recently took on a task, but I found that I couldn't complete this task. After thinking about it, I thought of Senior Brother Song. Who in the Baiyun faction doesn't know that Senior Brother Song is kind and reliable. There is no task that Senior Brother Song cannot complete, and there is nothing that Senior Brother Song dares not do."
"Junior brother, don't you want to give Senior Brother Song a fortune? The reward for this letter is very generous. Junior Brother is willing to give it all to you, Senior Brother. I wonder what Senior Brother wants?"
Senior Brother Song Zhenluo did not agree immediately, but stared at Xu Junbai with narrowed eyes.
Those eyes were very stressful, as if they wanted to see through Xu Junbai's heart.
Xu Junbai remained unchanged. After dealing with Senior Brother Song a lot, he naturally understood how to deal with it.
"What letter?"
Xu Junbai handed it over, and Senior Brother Song looked at it. The envelope was sealed and could not be opened by outsiders.
Feeling the spiritual energy fluctuations on the letter and the forbidden energy, Senior Brother Song looked a little strange.
"Junior brother, I wonder how much the reward for this letter is?"
Don’t agree yet, let’s negotiate the price first.
This is Senior Brother Song's caution and the way he asks for the price.
"Thirty spirit stones, how about that?"
Senior Brother Song Zhenluo narrowed his eyes and did not agree.
One look at it and you can tell that you are not satisfied with the price.
He asked again: "Where to send it?"
"Feixian Sect."
"Where?" Senior Brother Song sat up straight.
His eyes were somewhat focused, staring at Xu Junbai.
"Junior brother, where do you want to send this letter?"
"Feixianzong, is there any problem?"
Senior Brother Song's voice became louder.
